title: RPG Adventure Game Engine
summary: Complete RPG adventure featuring combat with ability cooldowns, inventory equipment, enemy loot drops, and experience progression.

configuration.title: Enemy Starting Health
configuration.description: Starting health of the boss opponent

steps.description: Initialize player hero and enemy boss actors
Execute attack sequence applying equipment bonuses and ability cooldowns
Grant loot drop into inventory and level up hero upon victory

explanations.beginner: This application creates an RPG battle game. Your hero fights monsters using special abilities with cooldowns, collects weapons into an inventory, equips items for extra power, and levels up when enemies are defeated.
explanations.intermediate: Composes `otter-official/game-entity` actors, inventory, and cooldown systems with `otter-official/math-utils`. Evaluates turn damage including equipment bonuses, manages skill readiness via timestamp differences, and levels up upon defeating the enemy.
explanations.advanced: Architected as a composable RPG engine. Blueprints provide the base combat math while recipe orchestration adds weapon equipment slots, loot tables, ability cooldown timers, and serialized save states via `file-helpers`.
